newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B share index ends down on Lujiazui.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B share index ends down on Lujiazui.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed down on Friday led by the weak performance of property developer Lujiazui on expectations of poor 1996 results, brokers said.
The index fell 1.040 points or 1.58 percent to 64.703 points, on volume of 13.0 million shares worth $6.6 million against Thursday's $5.3 million.
Market giant Lujiazui traded most, falling $0.024 or 2.56 percent to $0.912 after 3.45 million shares traded.
Brokers said falls on the A share market also had an impact on the B shares but they added that bargain-hunting was seen for some shares on expectations of good results.
Brokers said that heavy selling in Lujaizui had a negative impact on market sentiment and made most investors cautious to buy.
"Falls in the A share market late in the session also triggered domestic individual selling in the B share market," one broker said.

"The index is likely to rebound a little next week with bargain-hunting emerging," a second broker said. "But it will be difficult to rise above the 68-point level, and the movement between 62-68 points will continue in the short term."
Of 42 B shares, 39 traded, with 24 down, six flat and nine up.
Shanghai Tyre was the biggest loser on profit-taking selling, slipping $0.030 or 6.97 percent to $0.400, on volume of 54,000 shares.
Stationery producer Wing Sung followed on expectation of poor results, falling $0.016 or 5.55 percent to $0.272 on volume of 271,000 shares.
Shanghai A share market tumbled late in the session amid liquidation selling ahead of the weekend with market sentiment weakening, brokers said.

The A index ended down 20.829 points or 2.17 percent to 937.361 points, on volume of 282.8 million shares worth 2.6 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index fell 43.273 points or 1.77 percent to 2406.197 points.
Petroleum Long Champ was the biggest loser on institutional profit-taking, slipping 0.80 yuan or 7.20 percent to 10.30 yuan on volume of 779,100 shares.
